# vSOFS

**Home page:** [http://www.vnavigator.com.ru/](https://web.archive.org/web/20060204214147/http://www.vnavigator.com.ru/) (web archive)<br/>
**Author:** VNavigator Soft<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD), x65/x75 (SGOLD)

A file system plugin for Total Commander. Supports Siemens
x55, x65, and x75 phones and lets you use all the standard
Total Commander features for working with files.

The plugin copies, moves, and deletes files and folders, creates directories, preserves
file dates and attributes, and accepts the `CD`, `MD`, `RD`, and `DEL` commands from the command
line. The settings dialog provides phone information and an AT terminal.

The built-in AT Enabler connects x65–x75 phones through non-original cables, and the
OD 2 feature opens their hidden drives. Starting with version 1.7, C55, ME45, and SL45 are
supported via BFB Layer.
